dificultadDesc: Easy. Predominantly flat and gentle terrain with some moderate stages.
descripcion: The Galician section of the Portuguese Way with first-class hotel accommodation, personalized attention and all premium services included.
descripcionLarga: The Premium experience of the Portuguese Way from Tui elevates the pilgrimage to another level. Walk the most popular Galician Jacobean route while staying in selected superior category hotels.
Each stage is planned so you enjoy the Way without worries: door-to-door luggage transport, 24h phone assistance and recommended restaurants at every stop.
From historic Tui by the Miño river to the Plaza del Obradoiro, you'll live an unforgettable week with maximum comfort and the peace of mind of a fully personalized service.
epoca: All year (best in spring and autumn)
puntosDestacados: First-class and boutique hotel accommodation at each stage
The Cathedral of Santa María de Tui and its medieval old town
The railway viaducts of Redondela
The historic center of Pontevedra and the Basilica of Santa María la Mayor
Dinners at selected restaurants with premium Galician cuisine
24h personalized assistance throughout the route
Arrival at Santiago de Compostela Cathedral

etapas.desc: Reception at your premium hotel in Tui. Check-in, personalized briefing about the route and welcome dinner at a selected restaurant.
puntosInteres: Cathedral of Santa María de Tui
Miño river promenade with views to Valença (Portugal)

etapas.desc: First stage through rural paths and small villages among forests and fields. Your luggage will be waiting at the hotel.
puntosInteres: Casa Consistorial by architect Antonio Palacios

etapas.desc: Stage combining forest trails with small villages. Charming hotel in Redondela.
One of the most pleasant stages with paths through forests. Superior category hotel in the heart of Pontevedra.
puntosInteres: Basilica of Santa María la Mayor
Plaza de la Leña and Pilgrim Virgin Sanctuary

etapas.desc: Quiet stage through rural landscapes and vineyards. Spa hotel in Caldas de Reis.
puntosInteres: Thermal tradition of Caldas de Reis

etapas.desc: Walking through forests, villages and rural paths to Padrón, cradle of the Jacobean tradition.
puntosInteres: Town of Padrón, linked to the history of the Apostle

etapas.desc: Final stage with triumphant arrival in Santiago. Luxury hotel next to the historic center.
puntosInteres: Old town of Santiago, UNESCO World Heritage

dificultadDesc: Easy. The final stretch of the French Way with gentle terrain and excellent infrastructure.
descripcion: The last 115 km of the French Way, the most popular stretch. Superior category hotels, fine dining and exclusive attention at every stage.
descripcionLarga: The French Way from Sarria is the most popular stretch to earn the Compostela. In its Premium version, every detail is carefully curated to offer a high-level pilgrimage experience.
From Sarria, the Way traverses the most authentic Galicia: stone villages, ancient forests, traditional granaries and the legendary Arzúa region.
Selected hotels, Galician gourmet cuisine, luggage transport and personalized assistance make this an unparalleled pilgrimage experience.
puntosDestacados: Boutique and superior category hotels at each stage
Medieval old town and Fortress of Sarria
Monastery of Samos, one of the oldest in the West
The iconic 100 km milestones of the French Way
Premium gastronomy: pulpo á feira in Melide, Arzúa cheese
Monte do Gozo: first view of the Cathedral towers
Arrival at the Plaza del Obradoiro

etapas.desc: Reception at your premium hotel in Sarria. Personalized briefing, pilgrim kit delivery and welcome dinner.
puntosInteres: Fortress and medieval old town of Sarria

etapas.desc: First stage through forests, stone villages and rural Galician landscapes.
puntosInteres: Belesar reservoir and Miño river bridge
Fortress-church of San Nicolás in Portomarín

etapas.desc: Comfortable stage through rural paths and forests.
puntosInteres: Sierra de Ligonde and its medieval cruceiro
Romanesque church of Vilar de Donas

etapas.desc: Long stage passing through Melide where the Primitive Way joins. The famous pulpo á feira is a must-try.
puntosInteres: Melide: junction with the Primitive Way

etapas.desc: Pleasant stage through eucalyptus and forest trails. The penultimate day before Santiago.
puntosInteres: Rural villages with fountains and cruceiros

etapas.desc: Final stage with the growing excitement of arrival. Monte do Gozo with views of the Cathedral towers. Luxury hotel in the old town.
puntosInteres: Monte do Gozo: first view of the Cathedral
Old town of Santiago, UNESCO World Heritage

dificultadDesc: Easy. Predominantly coastal and flat profile with gentle slopes.
descripcion: The spectacular Galician coastal route with oceanfront hotels, first-class Atlantic cuisine and a completely exclusive coastal pilgrimage experience.
descripcionLarga: The Premium Coastal Portuguese Way from A Guarda is the ultimate coastal experience. Atlantic-view hotels, fresh seafood restaurants, and the privilege of walking with the ocean as your constant companion.
From picturesque A Guarda and the seaside Oia Monastery, the route advances through Baiona, Vigo and the Redondela estuary, with superior category accommodation at every stop.
From Redondela it joins the central Portuguese Way through Pontevedra, Caldas de Reis and Padrón, always with maximum comfort and fully personalized attention.
puntosDestacados: Hotels with Atlantic views and marine spas
Castro de Santa Trega and A Guarda fishing port
Oia Monastery facing the ocean
Monterreal Fortress and gourmet dining in Baiona
Panoramic views of the Cíes Islands from the Vigo estuary
Selected seafood restaurants at each stage
Plaza del Obradoiro and Santiago Cathedral

etapas.desc: Spectacular seaside stretch. Hotel with ocean views by the Oia Monastery.
Atlantic coast with constant views. Gourmet dinner in charming Baiona.
Varied stage with coast, trails and urban stretches. Superior hotel in Vigo.
Ups and downs with estuary views. In Redondela you join the inland Portuguese Way.
Forests, ancient paths and pilgrim atmosphere. Charming hotel in Pontevedra.
Green and comfortable stage. Thermal spa hotel in Caldas de Reis.
Relaxed stretch through villages and forest. Padrón, cradle of Jacobean tradition.
Final stage with triumphant arrival in Santiago. Luxury hotel by the old town.

dificultadDesc: Moderate. Combines flat stretches along the estuaries with inland stages with elevation.
descripcion: The historic maritime route with first-class hotels, exclusive Galician cuisine and personalized assistance at every stage of the way.
descripcionLarga: The Premium English Way from Ferrol offers the most authentic Galician pilgrimage with the highest level of service. Selected hotels at each stage, reference restaurants and personalized monitoring.
From the historic port of Ferrol, the itinerary borders spectacular estuaries before entering the green forests and rural landscapes of inland Galicia, always with exceptional accommodation.
Medieval towns like Pontedeume and Betanzos, the forest solitude of Hospital de Bruma and the arrival in Santiago compose an unforgettable experience with the comfort you deserve.
puntosDestacados: Superior category hotel in Ferrol with harbor views
Medieval town of Pontedeume and stone bridge over the Eume river
Excellence gastronomy in Betanzos
Premium rural accommodation in Hospital de Bruma
Native forests of oak and chestnut trees
24h personalized assistance throughout the route
Luxury hotel in Santiago to celebrate the arrival

etapas.desc: Departure from Ferrol port along the estuary. Gentle stage, perfect to get into rhythm. Charming hotel in Neda.
Pleasant walk through villages and green areas by the estuary. Boutique hotel in medieval Pontedeume.
Demanding stage with steep ascent at the start. Premium hotel in Betanzos with its monumental old town.
The hardest stage. Long, rural and authentic. Exclusive rural accommodation in Hospital de Bruma.
Easier stage through forest trails. Charming hotel in Sigüeiro.
Final stretch to the Plaza del Obradoiro. Luxury hotel by the historic center of Santiago.
